## What

Brief description of the change.

## Why

The problem this solves, or the decision behind it. Link an ADR if one applies.

## Checks

- [ ] `pnpm verify` clean
- [ ] Checked by eye in the Extension Development Host, per CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Any new role or surface is measured in `src/roles.test.ts` and recorded in ADR 0003
- [ ] Package contents unchanged, or `ALLOWED_FILES` and `.vscodeignore` updated together with a reason below

## Screenshots

Before and after, for any visible change.

## Notes

Anything a reviewer should look at closely, or a known trade-off being accepted.
